interpretation: Owner-occupied units divided by owner- plus renter-occupied units for the stated subgroup.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by people age 29 or younger
interpretation: LODES primary jobs held by people age 29 or younger.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by people age 30 to 54
interpretation: LODES primary jobs held by people age 30 through 54.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by people age 55 or older
interpretation: LODES primary jobs held by people age 55 or older.

metric_name: Workers commuting 30 to 59 minutes
interpretation: Workers with travel time from 30 through 59 minutes divided by workers who did not work from home.

metric_name: Workers commuting 60 minutes or more
interpretation: Workers with travel time of 60 minutes or more divided by workers who did not work from home.

metric_name: Workers commuting under 30 minutes
interpretation: Workers with travel time under 30 minutes divided by workers who did not work from home.

metric_name: Primary jobs paying more than $3,333 per month
interpretation: LODES primary jobs in the over-$3,333 monthly earnings band.

metric_name: Inbound share of primary jobs
interpretation: Primary jobs located in the county with a home geocode outside the county divided by county primary jobs.

metric_name: Same-county resident share of primary jobs
interpretation: Same-county home-and-work primary jobs divided by primary jobs located in the county.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by same-county residents
interpretation: Primary jobs whose workplace and home geocodes are in the same county.

metric_name: Primary jobs paying $1,250 per month or less
interpretation: LODES primary jobs in the $1,250-per-month-or-less earnings band.

metric_name: Primary jobs paying $1,251 to $3,333 per month
interpretation: LODES primary jobs in the $1,251-to-$3,333 monthly earnings band.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by residents of another California county
interpretation: Primary jobs located in the county whose home geocode is in another California county.

metric_name: Primary jobs held by residents outside California
interpretation: Primary jobs located in the county whose home geocode is outside California.

metric_name: Primary jobs located in county
interpretation: LODES JT01 primary jobs located in the county.

metric_name: Workers using public transportation
interpretation: Public-transportation commuters divided by workers age 16 and over.

metric_name: Workers working from home
interpretation: People working from home divided by workers age 16 and over.
